verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Enterprise, NetSuite, and other accounting platforms, plus manual CSV fallback, indicating transaction sync is supported; however, there is no explicit evidence for Xero support, and no documentation detailing finance-lead control over GL account, class, or department-level mapping configuration. missing for 10: explicit Xero sync support, documented GL account/class/department mapping controls, independent/hands-on confirmation of mapping accuracy.
